data.name: Name
data.price_interval_min: Interval without explicit end (15 or 60 minutes)
data.maximum_command_kwh: Maximum total energy per request, including Green (kWh)
data.idle_green_price_filter: Also use the Green price filter without a request
data.early_offset_cents: Early import: cents/kWh below the weighted day mean
data.capacity_entity: Charger status including safe-mode indication (read only)
data.safe_power_kw: Planning power during safe mode or Gateway outage (kW)
data.zonneplan_tax_eur_kwh: Energy tax already included in import, incl. VAT (EUR/kWh)
data.zonneplan_import_fee_eur_kwh: Import fee already included, incl. VAT (EUR/kWh)
data.zonneplan_bonus_eligible: Contract eligible for daylight Zonnebonus (requires annual counter)
data.bonus_export_ytd_entity: Actual bonus-relevant exported energy this calendar year (kWh)
data.bonus_export_year: Confirmed calendar year of the export counter (0 = entity year attribute)
data.maximum_export_kw: Physical maximum export for conservative bonus headroom (kW)
data.charger_fault_recovery: Preserve request across charger/Gateway faults and token refresh
data.maximum_manual_hours: Maximum total Manual time per request (hours)
data.fallback_power_entity: Fallback charger power when the independent source is unavailable (W/kW)
data.charger_connectivity_entity: Charger connectivity (separate from Gateway, read only)

start.name: Start charging request
start.description: With the master off this only simulates. With the master on, control the selected vehicle toward its target and departure.

set_target.name: Set target
set_target.description: Change own target/departure without resetting delivered energy. An inactive change does not start charging.

stop.name: Stop charging request
stop.description: Revoke resume rights and end only owned grid charging. Green remains the baseline.

follow_helpers.name: Follow bound helpers
follow_helpers.description: Remove local target/departure overrides and follow bound helpers without starting a new request.
